findings.excerpt: We sell and distribute most of our products in the U.S. exclusively through the wholesale channel. Historically, approximately 90% of our gross product sales in the U.S. have been to three large wholesalers—Cardinal Health, Inc., Cencora, Inc. and McKesson Corporation—and their specialty distributor affiliates.
